changelog:
Version 2.3 – Balancing & Quality of Life Update💰 Pack Pricing
Rebalanced card pack pricing to make it more realistic and balanced.

🎨 Custom Pack Designs
Added custom card pack designs featuring placeholder monsters on the front.

These will be updated over time to better match the actual contents of each pack.

Initial testing suggests the new designs may also provide a positive performance impact.

🔔 Update Checker
Added an automatic update checker.

You'll now receive a popup when loading into a game if a newer version of the mod is available.

⚔️ Duelling Engine
Further improved AI behaviour to prevent it from activating Spell and Trap cards against its own cards.

📦 Updating
Delete your old Dan's YuGiOh Expansion folder and install the new version.
